title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor's bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is small

translated_title: 跨循环查询交接：Ouro 循环语言模型中后续循环如何重定向两跳检索
translated_abstract: 在预训练的循环语言模型中，后续循环是如何修复两跳检索的？我们通过在相同层、头和最终提示位置上于不同循环之间移植注意力查询，研究了 Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 模型。在合成的上下文内问题上，将按层索引的循环3查询集合注入整个循环1中，可以挽救90%和97%的在循环1回答错误而在循环3回答正确的问题，而使用打乱顺序的供体查询仅能挽救24%和21%。在 Ouro-2.6B 中，这种挽救效果在贪心生成下依然成立；而在 Ouro-1.4B 中，该效果仅限于四候选排序任务。交叉的供体-受体交换更倾向于通过供体的桥接实体进行检索，而非复制其答案，尽管 Ouro-2.6B 中仍存在显著的位置成分。来自后期循环的键和值能挽救的目标则少得多。将查询冻结在循环1的取值上，对两跳准确率的损害大于提供桥接实体的匹配问题。在自然问题上，挽救效果较小。
tldr: 通过在 Ouro 循环语言模型的不同循环间移植注意力查询，研究发现后续循环的查询（而非键或值）是修复两跳多跳检索失败的关键机制，注入循环3的查询可挽救超过90%的循环1失败案例。
en_tdlr: By transplanting attention queries across loops in Ouro looped language models, this study shows that later-loop queries—not keys or values—are the key mechanism repairing failed two-hop retrieval, with loop-3 query injection rescuing over 90% of loop-1 failures.
